name: Kartu Kredit Jenius

memberLevels.name: Grow or above
memberLevels.condition: average monthly balance Rp 10.000.000 or more

notes: From 1 August 2026 earning and KrisFlyer conversion follow the Jenius Club status set by average monthly balance: Grow and above keep the old terms, Seed and Plant earn less and convert worse.

Double Yay covers foreign transactions and selected categories. Only the foreign half is estimated here: the list of selected categories was not in the sources, so a domestic purchase in one of them will be underestimated.

Seed and Plant: the source quotes Double Yay at about Rp 8.000 per KrisFlyer mile, but Rp 6.000 per Yay at the stated 50.000 Yay = 30.000 miles is Rp 10.000 per mile. Rp 8.000 only holds at the old 40.000 = 30.000 ratio, so it reads as a figure carried over and not updated. The published ratio is encoded; check this one against the Jenius app.

The GarudaMiles ratio is derived, not published: Rp 6.250 per mile at Rp 5.000 per Yay (Grow) and Rp 7.500 at Rp 6.000 (Seed and Plant) both give 0,8 miles per Yay, so GarudaMiles was not devalued. The step of 40.000 Yay is an assumption; the real minimum may differ.

From 1 August 2026 a purchase converted to a 0% instalment, including Split Pay 0% at a merchant or in the app, earns no Yay Points. An interest-bearing instalment still earns. Estimates cannot see instalment status, so a 0% instalment will be overestimated.
Conversion to KrisFlyer or GarudaMiles is limited to once a month, and capped at 30.000 KrisFlyer miles and 20.000 GarudaMiles a month. Neither limit is applied to estimates.
Yay Points can be forfeited when the card bill is more than 60 days late.
Rounding is taken as per full increment of the stated amount; the sources do not say how a part increment is treated.
The annual fee is Rp 500.000 a year, given by the cardholder rather than taken from the sources. The supplementary card fee is not known.
Every figure comes from secondary reporting, not from Jenius's own terms. Bank SMBC Indonesia's site could not be reached when this entry was written, so treat it as unverified against the issuer.
